bio.text: Ammie Akin is a Republican candidate for Alabama's 7th Congressional District in 2026.

According to her campaign website, she is an educator and entrepreneur who holds degrees from the University of Alabama and a master's degree and a doctorate in educational leadership from Samford University.
She and her husband Will are developing Hub in the Hills, a privately funded project to turn a former elementary school into a shared campus for nonprofit organizations, and they have three sons.
